summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of Shift Change beta. 24/24 backend pytest tests passed (auth, profile, shifts, workspace lifecycle, reviews, notifications, wallet, recommendations, WebSocket real-time chat). Frontend: homepage/manifesto intact; signup role-picker + email/pw path lands on /dashboard with correct earner headline; Alice login OK; profile edit + skill chip save OK; create-a-shift redirects to shift detail; shifts list, notifications, wallet (MOCKED disclaimer visible) all render; workspace opens with all 6 tabs (chat/tasks/files/timeline/notes/payment); chat send visible; task add + toggle; notes save; public /u/{userId} does not expose email or wallet.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid="nav-shifts" not present (sidebar exposes 'BROWSE' and 'MY SHIFTS' as separate links without a single nav-shifts testid). Recommend adding data-testid="nav-browse" and data-testid="nav-my-shifts" (or a nav-shifts) for stable selection.

data-testid="nav-logout" not present. Logout is rendered as an icon button next to the user card at the bottom of the sidebar with no data-testid; automated logout tests must fall back to role/text. Recommend adding data-testid="nav-logout".

action_items: Optional: add data-testid="nav-logout" to sidebar logout button and data-testid="nav-browse" / data-testid="nav-my-shifts" (or a combined nav-shifts) to sidebar links for testability.
No functional bugs to fix — beta is stable.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 619 lines and mixes all domains; consider splitting into routers (auth, shifts, workspaces, misc) if it grows further.

shifts list query builder: when both `mine=True` and `q` are passed, `$or` is overwritten by the second assignment (mine's $or is preserved via query.get('$or', []) fallback, actually OK — verified). Just worth adding a test for combined filter.
File upload accepts arbitrary base64 with no size limit — could DoS Mongo. Add server-side size cap even in prototype.
notify() writes _id then broadcasts full doc after pop — good pattern. Confirmed no ObjectId leaks in tested endpoints.
WSManager stores raw lists — no dead-socket pruning on send failure (silent pass). Fine for prototype, but list may grow; consider removing failed sockets.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all functional flows; 2 missing nav testids are cosmetic)

seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ shifts and one workspace by accepting shift via Alice + one workspace via UI signup user; also completed one shift in tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is reusable (uses websocket-client for WS test — install via pip if not present). Uses shiftchange.io emails because pydantic EmailStr rejects .test TLD. Test users seeded: alice+earn, bob+seek. Seeded workspace ws_4c4acf35bdca49 is used to open a workspace from the UI list; note that the payment_status of that workspace was flipped to 'paid' / 'released' by the E2E flow, so pay-btn may be absent on that workspace — accept a fresh shift to see the Mark Paid button.
